items.title: rebuild repo-local skills from latest orchestrator design
items.goal: 删除当前 repo-local skill 集，按最新实验 orchestrator 设计重建新 skill 骨架。

acceptance.text: The old repo-local skills are removed and replaced by new skeleton directories that match the latest root-level orchestrator skill names.
Each rebuilt skill contains a valid SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml skeleton.

notes: QUEUE.json is the machine-oriented queue source for active/open work.
Human-readable queue compatibility has been removed; use task JSON files and run evidence for manual review.
